draft.heroMessage: Southern Vermont Real Estate, Expertly Guided
draft.welcomeNote: Welcome! I'm Adam Palmiter, your trusted advisor for Mount Snow and Southern Vermont real estate. Since 2004, I've been dedicated to helping buyers and sellers find success—whether you're dreaming of a trailside condo, lakefront retreat, or country estate.
draft.tagline: #1 in Mount Snow and Vermont Real Estate
draft.aboutParagraph: Drawing on a lifetime in Southern Vermont and decades of real estate experience, I deliver personalized, data-driven service with professionalism and communication at every step. My background in marketing and technology, combined with local knowledge, ensures your experience will be efficient and rewarding. I've been honored as the region's top sales volume agent for over a decade, yet I treat every deal—no matter the price—with the same care, discretion, and expertise.
draft.conciergeLine: Looking for guidance on your Mount Snow or Deerfield Valley property? Contact me directly—I’ll make the process seamless and enjoyable.
draft.contactLine: Call or email anytime. I’m here to help you achieve your Vermont real estate goals.
draft.tone: Warmly professional, highly knowledgeable, approachable yet results-driven. Adam’s voice is welcoming, locally rooted, and service-focused.
